summary: The historical AES implementation hashes variable-width blocks without incorporating input length, allowing null padding to produce collisions. The fix adds a final AES round incorporating the original length in both 64-bit lanes. Reverse the write method in src/aes_hash.rs, which the existing padding regression test directly exercises; its shared assertions were updated by this fix. The imported description refers to a later implementation: this commit does not change the fallback hasher. Running this historical test requires an AES-capable x86/x86_64 target with target-feature=+aes. No builds or tests were run.
